title: Humiliation by Fellow Disciple
next_chapter_hook: Ling Yuan's gaze was like an ancient deep well, lingering on Chen Ji for three breaths. It was not the indifferent look of scrutinizing waste, but the cold assessment of a hunter examining prey—What was he evaluating?

text.content:
In the early morning at the Tianqing Sect Martial Arena, the thin mist had yet to dissipate, and a faint layer of dew clung to the Blue Stone slabs. Mo Xiansheng's meaningful gaze still lingered in Chen Ji's mind like a fine splinter, occasionally throbbing with dull pain. He knew the secret hidden behind the Turtle Shell was far heavier than it appeared on the surface, but now was not the time for deeper investigation.

Because Han Lie had arrived.

A domineering aura broke through the morning mist as the Xuanwu Sect's number one prodigy appeared at the entrance of the Martial Arena, followed by seven or eight Outer Disciples, each with excited expressions eager to watch the spectacle. Han Lie crossed his arms, a mocking smile playing at the corners of his mouth, his gaze sweeping across the crowd before finally landing on Chen Ji standing in the corner.

"Oh, isn't this the 'genius' of our Tianqing Sect?"

dialogue.content: Han Lie strode over with big steps, his voice loud enough for the entire Martial Arena to hear, "Waste Chen, I'm in a good mood today, so I'll give you a chance to make something of yourself—why don't you perform your 'waste's divine ability' for everyone? What do you say?"

text.content:
The surrounding disciples burst into laughter, and some even started cheering and applauding. Chen Ji swept his gaze across the surroundings, silently memorizing each face—who was laughing, who was watching coldly, who showed signs of sympathy. This information quickly filed itself in his mind—it would be useful someday.

Han Lie, seeing him remain silent, thought he was intimidated and became even more smug. He took a token from his embrace and casually tossed it to a disciple beside him: "Go, borrow the sect's treasured 'Spirit Testing Stone'. Our waste senior brother is going to perform his 'divine ability', so we need a fitting prop, right?"

dialogue.content: The Spirit Testing Stone glowed red, its Spiritual Energy fluctuation so faint it was almost negligible. Han Lie feigned amazement: "Wow! Such a powerful divine ability! It almost detected the spiritual energy in the air!"

text.content:
The laughter grew even more unrestrained, nearly lifting the roof off the Martial Arena. Chen Ji kept his head lowered, his expression unclear, his shoulders trembling slightly. An Outer Disciple muttered quietly: "Is Senior Brother Chen about to cry?"

Han Lie walked forward, reaching out to pat Chen Ji's shoulder. It was at this moment that Chen Ji raised his head.

His eyes were not red; his expression was eerily calm, his lips even slightly raised—a smile of understanding, of tolerance, and even a trace of pity.

"Senior Brother Han is right," Chen Ji spoke, his voice not loud, yet clearly reaching everyone present, "My 'divine ability' is indeed extraordinary. It's not for detecting spiritual energy, but for detecting the human heart."

dialogue.content: Han Lie froze for a moment, then burst into hearty laughter: "Detecting the human heart? Ha! Can a waste even detect the human heart? Then detect what this young master is thinking right now!"

text.content:
Chen Ji tilted his head, putting on a thoughtful expression, then spoke with perfect seriousness: "Senior Brother Han is currently thinking—why does he have to come here early morning to bully a waste? Did the senior brothers at Xuanwu Sect mock him again last night?" He paused, "After all, the Xuanwu Sect's number one prodigy defeated a Tianqing Sect servant—that definitely deserves celebration."

The laughter stopped abruptly.

Han Lie's face instantly flushed to the color of pork liver. Everyone present understood—Chen Ji was saying that Han Lie had come looking for trouble because he was不爽 elsewhere, using him as a punching bag. More viciously, he turned Han Lie's provocation into a joke with just four words: 'deserves celebration.'

"You—" Han Lie pointed at him, too angry to speak.

choice.prompt: Han Lie was rendered speechless, everyone was holding back their laughter—at this moment, how should one handle the situation?

choices.text: Press forward aggressively and add another blow
choices.description: While he's down, crush Han Lie's face into the ground, making everyone remember this lesson forever
choices.visible_cost: Completely offend Han Lie and establish a deadly feud
choices.visible_reward: The entire crowd was shocked, Han Lie lost all face, Chen Ji's reputation slightly increased
choices.risk_hint: Han Lie might resort to violence on the spot

text.content: Chen Ji sighed, his expression sincere as he spoke: "Senior Brother Han, don't be angry. I haven't finished yet. Actually, the greatest use of my 'heart-detecting' divine ability is—it can predict in advance when someone is coming to cause me trouble, so I can hide far away ahead of time and avoid getting beaten." He took two steps back, clasped his hands in salute, "Thank you for today's warning, Senior Brother Han. Chen is truly grateful."

choices.text: Know when to stop and retreat to advance
choices.description: Give Han Lie a way out, act as pitiful as possible, make everyone think Han Lie is bullying an honest person
choices.visible_cost: Give up the opportunity to strike at Han Lie
choices.visible_reward: Establish a victim persona, making Han Lie even more disliked
choices.risk_hint: Might be seen as weak and easy to bully by Han Lie

text.content: Chen Ji smiled bitterly and deeply bowed to Han Lie: "Senior Brother Han is right, I'm just a waste who shouldn't be embarrassing myself here. I'll leave now, I'll leave now..." As he spoke, he stumbled backward. Many disciples in the Martial Arena frowned at this scene. A Xuanwu Sect prodigy coming to Tianqing Sect to bully a servant disciple—what kind of ability is that?

choices.text: Steer the topic toward the Spirit Testing Stone
choices.description: Since the Spirit Testing Stone was mentioned, why not talk about the origin of this 'prop', making Han Lie unable to back down gracefully
choices.visible_reward: Use the Spirit Testing Stone to counterattack, letting everyone know Han Lie is the real joke

text.content: Chen Ji picked up the Spirit Testing Stone, examining it front and back, clicking his tongue in amazement: "Senior Brother Han is truly generous, borrowing a three-hundred-year-old antique just for a waste's performance. If this thing were in Xuanwu Sect, it would probably qualify for their treasure vault, right?" He looked at those around him, "Fellow brothers, do you know what era of spiritual energy this Spirit Testing Stone tests?" An older disciple's face changed slightly: "Is that... an artifact from an ancient sect?"

No matter which response was chosen, this farce concluded under everyone's gaze. Han Lie's expression was unpredictable, and finally he coldly snorted, leaving with his followers. The watching Outer Disciples gradually dispersed, discussing what they had witnessed in small groups.

"That waste... was quite interesting."
"Didn't you see how he shut Han Lie down? Han Lie's face turned completely green."
"Hmph, what ability does a waste have? Just quick with his tongue."

Chen Ji stood in place, his expression calm, as if none of it concerned him. But his gaze swept through the crowd, memorizing each face—who was mocking, who was sympathetic, who remained expressionless, who seemed contemplative. This information arranged itself in his mind like chess pieces, preparing for future games.

"Waste..." he murmured to himself, his lips slightly raised, "Even a waste has its uses."

choice.prompt: After Han Lie left, the atmosphere in the Martial Arena subtly shifted. Who should be observed at this time?

choices.text: Observe potential allies among the Outer Disciples
choices.description: Find those who didn't follow the crowd in their mockery—they might be worth recruiting

text.content: Chen Ji's gaze locked onto a thin figure at the edge of the crowd—an Outer Disciple named Zhou Yuan, who throughout everyone's laughter had kept his head lowered, his expression complicated. Chen Ji noticed this person's fists were tightly clenched, as if suppressing something. Chen Ji noted this name in his heart.

choices.text: Remember those who mocked the most fiercely
choices.description: Chen Ji never lets losses go—today's debt will be settled one by one in the future
choices.visible_reward: Establish an enemy list—there will be opportunities later
choices.risk_hint: Remembering too many people might spread one's energy thin

text.content: Chen Ji silently compiled a list in his heart: Wang Tiezhu, Sun Xiaoshan, Zhao Mazi... not one of the most boisterous mockers escaped his memory. It's not that there won't be retribution, just that the time hasn't come. He lowered his eyes, hiding the cold glint that flickered through them.

choices.text: Observe whether any Inner Disciples are paying attention
choices.description: Will Inner Disciples like Su Qingyao notice the commotion here?
choices.visible_reward: Understand what image one presents to the higher-ups

text.content: Chen Ji casually glanced toward the distant viewing platform—where Inner Disciples typically had their morning training, but he didn't see Su Qingyao's figure. Instead, he caught sight of an unexpected figure walking toward this direction. That figure walked with steady steps, his aura restrained yet commanding, exuding quiet authority—an unexpected presence approaching.

The commotion in the Martial Arena gradually subsided, and the morning mist slowly dissipated under the rising sun. Just as Chen Ji was about to leave, a steady aura approached from nearby.

Footsteps came unhurried and unhasty, each step striking the Blue Stone slabs with a dull echo. Chen Ji didn't turn around—he could feel that gaze, piercing through the morning light, landing on his back.

Ling Yuan.

The elderly patriarch of Tianqing Sect, rumored to have half-stepped into the Yuan Ying realm. Normally, he rarely appeared in areas where Outer Disciples gathered, yet today, for unknown reasons, he had come to the edge of this Martial Arena.

The surrounding disciples quickly made way, bowing respectfully. Someone whispered: "Why is the Patriarch here today?" "I don't know... look, he seems to be looking at that waste."

Chen Ji slowly turned, bowing to Ling Yuan. His posture was impeccable in its deference, his lowered eyelids perfectly concealing the emotions in his eyes.

"Disciple Chen Ji greets the Patriarch."

Ling Yuan said nothing. He simply gazed quietly at Chen Ji, his eyes deep as two ancient wells, making it impossible to see what lay within. That gaze lingered on Chen Ji for three breaths—in others' eyes, perhaps merely a casual glance from an elder to a junior, but Chen Ji felt an invisible pressure.

It was not the indifferent look of scrutinizing waste.

It was the assessment of a hunter examining prey.

"...Mm." Ling Yuan finally spoke, uttering just a single syllable before turning to leave. His footsteps gradually faded, as if nothing had happened.

But Chen Ji knew that those three breaths of注视 were anything but ordinary. Mo Xiansheng's words resurfaced in his mind—the Turtle Shell's origin, the secret of the Tianji Record, the old Patriarch's secret observations... was there some connection between all these?

He lowered his eyes, pressing this question暂时压在心底. The chess game was too vast—no need to rush.
